name: stremio-offline
description: Self-hosted web client for Stremio addons

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:e2e:docker: npm run build && docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.56.1-noble npx playwright test
